content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm planning to create a temperature controller using [product_name]. I intend to use PT100 sensors together with the related [product_name] expansion module. Since I don't have prior experience with these sensors or with [product_name], I'm interested to hear if anyone has encountered any challenges with this setup. Additionally, I would like to adjust the set point using the keypad. Please let me know if the keypad can be used for this purpose. Thank you all for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is proposing a temperature controller project utilizing [product_name] with PT100 sensors and an expansion module. They are unfamiliar with both components and are seeking advice about any potential difficulties with integration and using the keypad to set the desired temperature. Their main concern is how smoothly the sensors and modules work together and whether the keypad allows easy set point adjustment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for simple integration between PT100 sensors and [product_name], straightforward configuration using the expansion modules, and the ability to set control parameters directly via the keypad interface.
